items.title: 最小 Obsidian-first 閱讀、教材投影與原句便利貼
items.outcome: 使用者從普通 Obsidian Markdown 開始閱讀，沿教材結構回到同一來源身分，並能建立可展開、可收合、可重開讀回且不覆寫原文的 context-local 便利貼。
completion_conditions: 普通文章入口、教材投影、Canvas/Web reference 共用可 read-back 的 Concept/Relation/Evidence identity
原句便利貼保存 anchor、source revision、provenance，取消不留垃圾且不自動升格 Concept
來源 snapshot 不變；regeneration 不覆寫 user-owned note；render/click 與重開 read-back 通過
同一候選 deterministic verification、Completion Gate、Trusted Publisher 與獨立產品審查通過
必要 Mac 人工試用完成；iPad/iPhone 未實測部分保持外部 gate，不用 viewport 冒充
forbidden_substitutes: Web-first 或第二個通用 Markdown editor
以 PR #29 已有 Commit、舊測試或舊 active 宣告冒充完成
以 AI 補寫 unsupported clause 或靜默改原文

approval_eligibility.reason: LEGACY-ISSUE-9-DISPOSITION is durably recorded in docs/control-plane/LEGACY_ISSUE9_DISPOSITION_20261023.md. PR #29 remains historical, and its three Round 4 findings are explicit unfinished obligations in the new immutable O2 spec.
approval_eligibility.release_condition: Owner approves exact Goal version 2026-10-23.1-bounded-trial and canonical spec digest after the trial-readiness infrastructure candidate passes independent review and is authorized for merge/deployment.

existing_evidence_disposition.reuse_rule: Preserve reviews, commits, budgets and checkpoints without migration. Selective code reuse starts from current main; Round 4 findings remain O2 obligations and old evidence never proves the new candidate complete.

items.title: Obsidian-first 精確續學與可攜局部 context
items.outcome: 從文章、結構入口或命令回到同一 source version、anchor、問題、實際回答、提示、解說與未釐清處，且能輸出 provider-neutral 局部續學包。
completion_conditions: 兩個 item 切換、關閉重開、source revision 與 stale/tampered anchor 正反向驗證通過
confusion 與暫緩支線保留為 append-only evidence，不以最近開過清單替代
Obsidian UI 人工 smoke 與同候選獨立審查完成
forbidden_substitutes: 把 AI 提及當使用者理解

approval_eligibility.release_condition: O2 Product Goal is CLOSED and O3 relevant source versions have no unresolved drift.

existing_evidence_disposition.reuse_rule: Reuse public resume/continuity domains and SC-03 evidence; Obsidian projection and human smoke remain new evidence.

items.title: 獨立 Soak／浸泡閉環
items.outcome: 使用者可從 reviewed Evidence 看完整答案與舊例子、滑走或暫停，不需輸入且只形成 Exposure；可主動轉 Practice。
completion_conditions: Soak/Practice answer isolation、offline/reload、overdue、暫停與無 debt 負例通過
Concept/Edge/neighborhood 保留來源與 scope
產品入口 render/click 與獨立審查通過
forbidden_substitutes: 把 Practice 或 Due 清單改名 Soak

existing_evidence_disposition.reuse_rule: Reuse Exposure/review/scheduling stores and existing tests; integrate only against the closed O2/O3 identity path.

items.title: 來源支持的分階段單題 Practice
items.outcome: 由 reviewed Source span 建立原文 cloze/選項，再依明確選擇或 evidence 進到提示/無提示回想；Attempt、feedback、confusion、retry 均可追溯並返回原 anchor。
completion_conditions: 答案隔離、immutable Attempt、idempotent retry/feedback、skip/snooze 正反例通過
題目距離原文與 transfer 目的可辨
產品 UI 與同候選獨立審查通過
forbidden_substitutes: 顯示答案後仍稱無輔助回想
用 mastery 百分比作 gate

existing_evidence_disposition.reuse_rule: Reuse public Attempt/Exposure/feedback/scheduling and practice surfaces; old component tests are not integrated product acceptance.

items.title: 問題路由、可審文章擴充與選定事件回流
items.outcome: 問題先以 literal/heading/linked-note 回到來源；不足才進經授權 AI adapter，所有文章擴充與選定事件回流有 preview、attribution、delta 與 revision。
completion_conditions: imprecise retrieval、not-found、parent/child question、revision reopen 通過
live provider 前 egress/cost/retention/付款拒絕與人工授權成立
AI-only 候選不生成理解或未審可考內容
同候選獨立審查通過
forbidden_substitutes: 先上 embedding 取代 literal retrieval

approval_eligibility.release_condition: O5 is CLOSED and any live-provider egress/cost boundary receives separate exact Owner authority.

existing_evidence_disposition.reuse_rule: Reuse context/evidence and adapter boundaries only; FD-10/12/14 gaps remain explicit.

items.title: 複習地圖、Knowledge Roaming 與多 Space
items.outcome: Due Queue 與教材結構圖共用 schedule projection；roaming 只顯示有行為 evidence 或 override 的 Concept，未知邊界可提問；至少兩個不同領域 Space 共用 engine 且同名異義不強併。
completion_conditions: 教材 structure 與 roaming Concept graph 不混淆
Exposure/skip/overdue/zero-activity 不產生 mastery 或 debt
兩領域與非 CS fixture 的 identity、pause isolation、unresolved edge 通過
人類可操作 UI 與同候選獨立審查通過
forbidden_substitutes: view grouping 升格 canonical Edge

existing_evidence_disposition.reuse_rule: Reuse graph read model, planner, local neighborhood, scheduling and Canvas adapters; roaming eligibility and multi-Space evidence remain incomplete.
